children: EverCommerce said its board approved a $25 million increase to the company's share-repurchase program, bringing the total authorization to $325 million.
The program is slated to run through Dec. 31, 2027, the company added.
The company has a market capitalization of $1.15 billion, 176.67 million shares outstanding, and a public float of 13.95 million shares.
The stock closed today's regular session down 3.3%, at $6.31.
EverCommerce provides software-as-a-service solutions for small- and medium-sized businesses.
